c.id, c.merchant_id, c.merchant_owner_member_id, c.merchant_name_snapshot, c.segment_id, c.segment_filter_json, c.channel, c.coupon_id, c.title, c.content, c.actor_member_id, c.actor_role_code, c.request_id, c.status, c.recipient_count, c.delivered_count, c.no_consent_count, c.frequency_skipped_count, c.failed_count, c.started_at, c.finished_at, c.processing_token, c.processing_lease_until, c.version, c.create_time, c.update_time, (select count(1) from merchant_crm_campaign_recipient retry where retry.merchant_id = c.merchant_id and retry.campaign_id = c.id
and retry.status in ('FAILED', 'SKIPPED_FREQUENCY', 'RETRYABLE_BUSY') and coalesce(retry.failure_code, '') <> 'DELIVERY_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN' and retry.attempt_count < 20) as retryable_count
id, merchant_id, member_id, channel, delivery_date, campaign_id, recipient_id, status, lease_token, lease_until, version, message_receipt_id, coupon_history_id, failure_code

id, campaign_id, merchant_id, member_id, customer_name_snapshot, channel, consent_event_id_snapshot, status, attempt_count, failure_code, failure_message, message_receipt_id, coupon_history_id, delivered_at, last_attempt_at, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: insert into merchant_crm_campaign (merchant_id, merchant_owner_member_id, merchant_name_snapshot, segment_id, segment_filter_json, channel, coupon_id, title, content, actor_member_id, actor_role_code, request_id, status, recipient_count, delivered_count, no_consent_count, frequency_skipped_count, failed_count, create_time, update_time) values (#{merchantRowId}, #{ownerMemberId}, #{merchantNameSnapshot}, #{segmentId}, #{segmentFilterJson}, #{channel}, #{couponId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{actorMemberId}, #{actorRoleCode}, #{requestId}, 'READY', #{recipientCount}, 0, 0, 0, 0, now(), now())

insert into merchant_crm_campaign_recipient (campaign_id, merchant_id, member_id, customer_name_snapshot, channel, consent_event_id_snapshot, status, attempt_count, create_time, update_time) values (#{campaignId}, #{merchantId}, #{memberId}, #{customerNameSnapshot}, #{channel}, #{consentEventIdSnapshot}, 'PENDING', 0, now(), now())

insert ignore into merchant_crm_delivery_guard (merchant_id, member_id, channel, delivery_date, campaign_id, recipient_id, status, lease_token, lease_until, version, create_time, update_time) values (#{merchantId}, #{memberId}, #{channel}, current_date, #{campaignId}, #{recipientId}, 'RESERVED', #{leaseToken}, date_add(now(3), interval #{leaseSeconds} second), 0, now(3), now(3))
mapper.select: select from merchant_crm_campaign c where c.merchant_id = #{merchantId} and c.request_id = #{requestId} limit 1
select from merchant_crm_campaign c where c.merchant_id = #{merchantId} and c.request_id = #{requestId} limit 1 lock in share mode
select from merchant_crm_campaign c where c.merchant_id = #{merchantId} and c.id = #{campaignId} limit 1
select id from merchant_crm_campaign_recipient where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and campaign_id = #{campaignId} and status = 'PENDING' order by id asc limit #{limit}
select from merchant_crm_campaign_recipient where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and campaign_id = #{campaignId} and id = #{recipientId} for update
select from merchant_crm_delivery_guard where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and member_id = #{memberId} and channel = #{channel} and delivery_date = current_date for update
select from merchant_crm_delivery_guard where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and campaign_id = #{campaignId} and recipient_id = #{recipientId} for update
mapper.update: update merchant_crm_campaign set status = 'PROCESSING', started_at = coalesce(started_at, now()), finished_at = null, processing_token = #{processingToken}, processing_lease_until = date_add(now(3), interval #{leaseSeconds} second), version = version + 1, update_time = now() where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and id = #{campaignId} and status = #{expectedStatus}
mapper.select: select from merchant_crm_campaign c where c.status = 'PROCESSING' and c.processing_lease_until < now(3) order by c.processing_lease_until asc, c.id asc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update merchant_crm_campaign_recipient set status = 'PENDING', failure_code = null, failure_message = null, update_time = now() where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and campaign_id = #{campaignId} and status in ('FAILED', 'SKIPPED_FREQUENCY', 'RETRYABLE_BUSY') and coalesce(failure_code, '') <> 'DELIVERY_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN' and attempt_count < 20

update merchant_crm_campaign_recipient set status = #{status}, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, failure_code = #{failureCode}, failure_message = #{failureMessage}, last_attempt_at = now(), update_time = now() where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and campaign_id = #{campaignId} and id = #{recipientId} and status = 'PENDING'

update merchant_crm_campaign_recipient set status = 'DELIVERED', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, failure_code = null, failure_message = null, message_receipt_id = #{messageReceiptId}, coupon_history_id = #{couponHistoryId}, delivered_at = now(), last_attempt_at = now(), update_time = now() where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and campaign_id = #{campaignId} and id = #{recipientId} and status = 'PENDING'

update merchant_crm_campaign_recipient set status = 'FAILED', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, failure_code = #{failureCode}, failure_message = #{failureMessage}, last_attempt_at = now(), update_time = now() where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and campaign_id = #{campaignId} and id = #{recipientId} and status = 'PENDING'

update merchant_crm_campaign_recipient set status = 'RETRYABLE_BUSY', failure_code = 'DELIVERY_BUSY', failure_message = #{failureMessage}, update_time = now() where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and campaign_id = #{campaignId} and id = #{recipientId} and status = 'PENDING'

update merchant_crm_delivery_guard set lease_token = #{leaseToken}, lease_until = date_add(now(3), interval #{leaseSeconds} second), version = version + 1, update_time = now(3) where id = #{guardId} and status = 'RESERVED' and lease_until < now(3) and version = #{expectedVersion}

update merchant_crm_delivery_guard set status = 'FAILED_UNCERTAIN', lease_token = null, lease_until = null, failure_code = #{failureCode}, version = version + 1, update_time = now(3) where id = #{guardId} and status = 'DISPATCHING' and lease_until < now(3) and version = #{expectedVersion}

update merchant_crm_campaign c set c.recipient_count = (select count(1) from merchant_crm_campaign_recipient r where r.merchant_id = #{merchantId} and r.campaign_id = #{campaignId}), c.delivered_count = (select count(1) from merchant_crm_campaign_recipient r where r.merchant_id = #{merchantId} and r.campaign_id = #{campaignId} and r.status = 'DELIVERED'), c.no_consent_count = (select count(1) from merchant_crm_campaign_recipient r where r.merchant_id = #{merchantId} and r.campaign_id = #{campaignId} and r.status = 'SKIPPED_NO_CONSENT'), c.frequency_skipped_count = (select count(1) from merchant_crm_campaign_recipient r where r.merchant_id = #{merchantId} and r.campaign_id = #{campaignId} and r.status = 'SKIPPED_FREQUENCY'), c.failed_count = (select count(1) from merchant_crm_campaign_recipient r where r.merchant_id = #{merchantId} and r.campaign_id = #{campaignId} and r.status = 'FAILED'), c.status = case when (select count(1) from merchant_crm_campaign_recipient r where r.merchant_id = #{merchantId} and r.campaign_id = #{campaignId}) = 0 then 'NO_ELIGIBLE' when (select count(1) from merchant_crm_campaign_recipient r where r.merchant_id = #{merchantId} and r.campaign_id = #{campaignId} and r.status <> 'DELIVERED') = 0 then 'SUCCESS' else 'PARTIAL_FAILED' end, c.finished_at = now(), c.processing_token = null, c.processing_lease_until = null, c.update_time = now() where c.merchant_id = #{merchantId} and c.id = #{campaignId} and c.status = 'PROCESSING' and c.processing_token = #{processingToken}
